title: 18 free horror asset packs generated entirely from code with Claude Code: models, pixel art, sounds and Godot tests
author: -lesed-
selftext:
I make horror game assets without drawing or recording anything by hand. The workflow:

\- Claude Code writes Python that builds everything procedurally: low-poly models, rigs and animations in Blender (bpy), pixel art from shapes and 5-tone ramps, sounds synthesised in numpy. No image or audio models; the AI writes the generators.  
\- Every pack ships with a Godot 4 demo, and an automated Godot test runs on the unzipped zip before release.  
\- Previews are captured from the same demo, so what you see is what's in the pack.

The video shows all 18 free ones: a PS1 rat swarm, PS1 and snow shaders, VHS / found-footage overlays and HUDs, a phone UI, a 90s desktop, skyboxes, backrooms textures, pixel sprites and effects, sounds, a pixel font, and an analog-horror warning generator.

What I learned: generating is the easy part; checking is the job. The model reports "done" while a hand clips through a bag, so every build ends with contact sheets I review myself plus tests that measure things.

All free: https://lesed.itch.io. Happy to answer questions about the pipeline.
